tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full detail of one presentation by its altId (the 7-character public id every search result carries): price as the store shows it, stock, prescription requirement, category and canonical URL. Answers null for an unknown altId.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The catalogue tree as a flat list: title, slug, PLP URL and parentSlug. Slugs are valid `category` arguments for search_products.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Free-text search over BuscaMed's catalogue of medicines and health products. Returns presentations with price, stock and canonical URL; a product not sold online is listed without a price and availableForOnlineSale=false. Optionally narrow to a category slug from list_categories (a parent category covers its children).
